content.short: Pixel Links NFTs are a non-fungible tokens used as Characters and Equipment to create your Pixel Links Golfer.
content.description:
Pixel Links NFTs are a non-fungible tokens used as Characters and Equipment to create your Pixel Links Golfer, and as Golf Holes used to create your Pixel Links Golf Course. Players of Pixel Links can collect, develop, and compete with the Pixel Links NFTs. A Pixel Links NFT blurs the boundary between a Video Game asset existing in the real world and existing in the virtual world. Pixel Links NFTs are a special type of token that exists on the Cardano Blockchain, they are unique, and retain individual value irrespective of the value of other Pixel Links NFTs. This means that the Thousandth Pixel Link NFT created holds its own value, irrespective of what any other Pixel Link NFT is worth. Because NFTs exist inside and outside of the virtual space, there is no requirement ever to use the Pixel Links NFTs to play the game. You can collect them all, never play the game, and just lovingly admire them in your Cardano Wallet. There are many factors that influence how low a golfer can score – from physical attributes of the golfer, to the weather out on the course. There are some golfers that can’t play in anything but perfect conditions, and there are others that thrive in the worst of weathers and seasons. In the world of Pixel Links your golfers are just the same. A Pixel Links Golfer is a unique character that is composed of several physical and mental characteristics. Pixel Links Golfers use Pixel Links Equipment. Pixel Links Equipment is unique Golfing Equipment (such as clubs and golfballs) used by the Pixel Links Golfer to play on Pixel Links Golf Courses. Pixel Links Golf Course is a unique collection of 9 or 18 Pixel Links Holes in which other Pixel Links Golfers will come and play. Pixel Links was created Alex Simpson and Bill Manwaring. Both met through their shared interest in playing Magic: The Gathering at Bill’s shop “RobinsHobby Café” in Belfast, Northern Ireland. Alex has spent far too long at sea, whilst Bill has spent far too many nights following Politicians around the halls of power, and both desire a way to live healthier more respectful lives whilst still doing the things they love. Alex loves Golf, and Bill loves tech and so Pixel Links was a match made in heaven.
